exclusions.name: Features with equal support
exclusions.reason: No feature medals when all three products have the same verified support grade. Equal comparison rows are omitted; equal grades do not imply identical implementations. Excluded: Volume and folder scans, Direct NTFS / MFT scan, Treemap, Extension totals, Largest files, CSV export, Unattended scan + CSV export, Delete / move files inside analyzer, Logical / allocated size accounting, Regex search, Scan-time include/exclude rules, Multiple scan roots in one catalog, Treemap logical/allocated size modes, CSV timestamp timezone selection, Batch/folder cleanup, Explorer shell context menu.

exclusions.name: Raw MFT phases and directory-walk engine
exclusions.reason: Component measurements remain in the report, but are not extra medals for the same product/workload.

exclusions.name: Cache, incremental updates and input latency
exclusions.reason: Three-run measurements are missing for one or more products; missing values never receive a bronze medal.

exclusions.name: Correctness, allocation and treemap rendering
exclusions.reason: Reported separately as correctness/behavior findings; fastest or lowest is not necessarily correct.

exclusions.name: Product-specific feature performance
exclusions.reason: Timings/resources remain visible; workflows supported by fewer than three products or with different boundaries do not earn performance medals. Feature-support medals apply only to retained parity differences.

competitorBaselinePolicy: WinDirStat and WizTree retain the lowest validated n=10 statistic per medal metric and executable version/hash. Subsequent iterations reuse complete competitor baselines until their version or executable hash changes; missing baselines require collection. WinBlaze is rerun and uses the latest validated batch per metric; pending refreshes retain their dated previous result. Each metric may select a different dated batch. Raw latest observations remain separately dated.
